items.previewTitle: Towhid Hridoy's 242* creates history as Bangladesh batter shatters all-time Test record against West Indies
items.previewSummary: Towhid Hridoy produced a knock for the ages, smashing an unbeaten 242 to script history for Bangladesh and pull his side back from the brink in the second Test against West Indies in Sylhet. In an innings that combined extraordinary resilience with breathtaking power-hitting, Hridoy registered the highest individual score by a Bangladesh batter in Test cricket, transforming a potential first-innings collapse into a 30-run lead.

items.previewTitle: AI investment cycle: AI investment cycle may have peaked, Jefferies warns; raises India allocation to 14% - The Economic Times
items.previewSummary: According to a recent Jefferies report, global investment in artificial intelligence appears to be facing a mid-cycle correction. Although US tech giants have ramped up their capital spending, there are growing concerns regarding both financing and profitability. This situation may adversely impact US economic growth. Investors are advised to explore opportunities outside the AI realm, especially in healthcare and biotechnology sectors.
